crossRefs.note: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.
He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.
Before Isaiah had gone out into the middle part of the city, Yahweh’s word came to him, saying,
“Turn back, and tell Hezekiah the prince of my people, ‘Yahweh, the God of David your father, says, “I have heard your…
The centurion answered, “Lord, I’m not worthy for you to come under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be…
Yahweh my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.
Yahweh, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,
who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,
He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
Yahweh said to Moses, “Make a venomous snake, and set it on a pole. It shall happen that everyone who is bitten, when…
Moses made a serpent of bronze, and set it on the pole. If a serpent had bitten any man, when he looked at the serpent…
“If there is beside him an angel, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to show to man what is right for him;
But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me.
For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light…
He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life will see the light.’

translations.web: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.
translations.bsb: He sent forth His word and healed them; He rescued them from the Pit.
translations.kjv: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.
translations.asv: He sendeth his word, and healeth them, And delivereth them from their destructions.
